email.subject: Core Group Fitness: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

Looked at Core Group Fitness's site. Two things likely costing you members:

No click-to-call on mobile. Someone searching "gym near me" on their phone has to copy and dial your number manually instead of tapping once. Most just move on to the next result.

The footer still shows old info (hours, promo, or similar), which makes the site look abandoned and can make people second-guess whether you're still open.

Both are quick fixes. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
